Priya (PM): Quick sync  we need one clear rule for when something is MVP vs bumped to v1. My suggestion: any feature that touches tenant data migration or auth becomes v1 unless explicit customer opt-in. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): +1. Practical add: mark feature with 'data-affecting' flag in cutlist. If flagged, require Eng lead + PM + customer advocate to approve for MVP.
Leah (Design): From UX: anything flagged needs fallback screens and a short-run checklist. If we can't ship fallback in 48h, it should be v1.
Tay (SRE): Operational guard: add a deployment hold if pilot error budget > 10% or any data-loss bug reported. That hold triggers immediate triage; PM owns decision to push to v1.
